recurring_harms: physical injury;opportunity or care loss;privacy loss;misinformation or manipulation;loss of autonomy
human_in_loop_decisions: Pause or override a safety-critical AV test; route a potentially urgent health interaction to qualified care; approve or reverse high-reach political-content action with local-context evidence.
strongest_guardrails: No autonomous continuation without an authorized human; immutable decision and evidence log; hard stop on critical threshold breach; independent review before restart or scope expansion.
cross_industry_pattern: Across all three products, a nominal human reviewer is insufficient: the roadmap must gate any scope expansion on a reviewer who has timely context, explicit authority to pause or override, an auditable record, and an incident-triggered re-review.
